name: icon-tile
title: Icon tile
description: A mark for what a row, a card or an empty place is about: a glyph, or one to three characters in the engraved mono, in a sunk window (or a small raised plate) beside the words that name it. Compact 28, regular 32, large 44, hero 56; square or round; a thing's state as the LED seated on the top-right rim, flickering once when it changes. Never pressed, never tinted; decorative unless labelled.
base: none (a span; role img only when labelled)
